catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class stops a fluid.pump: cap.motion.stop.v1 lists only robot.arm, robot.mobile_base and motion.axis as resource kinds, and cap.actuation.pump.v1 is a dosing action that requires a dispensed_volume output. This extension is the safe-state action required for this R2 hardware driver and takes no input.

notes:
Gate G1-G9 passed with no warnings on the fake backend; the digest above is from that last run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: a direct Driver with native.py rather than the PythonObjectDriver helper, because the upstream builds every command from the pump address, a command word and an argument (pumpy.py:82-83) and the PHD2000 overrides the stop and target-volume replies (pumpy.py:271-308); the package binds the card's PHD2000 entry symbol. Covered: the Harvard PHD2000 through pumpy.PHD2000; reads of the configured diameter, flow rate and target volume; the sourced 0.1-35 mm diameter limit; the operator-required flow-rate and target-volume writes and the cap.actuation.pump.v1 action (flow_rate in uL/s converted to the native uL/min by multiplying by 60). The native STP is both @estop and the safe-state extension action. NOT COVERED: the Pump 11, Pump 11 Plus and Mighty Mini classes of the clone (this package binds PHD2000 only); continuous infusion or withdrawal without a target volume; the duration_s input of cap.actuation.pump.v1 (the upstream API drives volume, not a duration); detection or setting of the PHD2000 keypad volume mode, which the README says is required before the pump takes notice of a target volume (README.md:81). The hardware path in native.py was not run and no hardware was attached. The fake is an in-memory stand-in for the upstream object, not a recording of the pump; its numbers are test data marked # placeholder, and it does not reproduce the serial protocol. Limits: diameter is sourced to pumpy.py:96; flow rate and target volume are Limit.operator_required because the clone gives no static range, and site-limits.example.json is an illustrative operator overlay, not a statement about any pump. The package is model-authored and unreviewed; reviewed_by is null. The catalogue_requests entry above covers only the stop extension; cap.actuation.pump.v1 is a catalogue class.
